key.stronghold_finder.capture: Add ray (Shift: from the flying eye)
message.stronghold_finder.no_eye: Didn't see an Eye of Ender
message.stronghold_finder.overworld_only: Rays only work in the Overworld
stronghold_finder.advice.first_throw: Throw an eye and press Shift+G right away, or aim at it and press G. Walk sideways and repeat.
stronghold_finder.advice.move_aside: Walk 200–300 blocks %s or %s, sideways from the ray, and throw again.
stronghold_finder.advice.go: You can go. Throw another eye on the way to refine the point.
stronghold_finder.advice.refine: To refine, walk about %s blocks %s or %s and throw again.
stronghold_finder.advice.behind: The rays diverge. A minus sign may be missing, or the eye pointed at another stronghold: near the world center they are almost equally far.
stronghold_finder.advice.behind_some: Some rays diverge and were left out of the average. Check the angles: the eye may have pointed at another stronghold.
stronghold_finder.advice.parallel: The rays are nearly parallel or their crossings are off. Walk further sideways and throw again.
stronghold_finder.advice.weak: The rays meet at a sharp %s° angle, so the point is very rough.
stronghold_finder.advice.outside_rings: The point is outside the stronghold rings: %2$s blocks short of ring %1$s. One of the throws is probably wrong.
screen.stronghold_finder.title: Stronghold Finder
screen.stronghold_finder.hint: Space or Enter moves to the next field; after yaw the throw is added. You can paste an F3+C line or three numbers.
screen.stronghold_finder.bad_paste: Could not read that. Paste an F3+C line or three numbers: X Z yaw.
screen.stronghold_finder.minimap_failed: The gold point on the minimap is off after an error. See the game log
screen.stronghold_finder.map_failed: Could not show throws on the map. See the game log for details.
